title: SIM Acquisition Corp. I 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: SIM Acquisition Corp. I, a SPAC listed on Nasdaq (tickers: SIMAU, SIMA, SIMAW), filed a Form 8-K on April 22, 2026 announcing the postponement of its shareholder meeting from April 23, 2026 to May 1, 2026. The meeting is being held to vote on extending the company's deadline to complete an initial business combination from July 11, 2026 to July 12, 2027.
key_points: Shareholder meeting postponed from April 23, 2026 to May 1, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET
Meeting to be held at Ellenoff Grossman & Schole LLP, 1345 Avenue of the Americas, 11th Floor, New York, NY 10105
Purpose: vote on extension amendment to extend the business combination deadline from July 11, 2026 to July 12, 2027
Redemption deadline extended to April 29, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. ET (two business days prior to meeting)
Company is an emerging growth company as defined under Rule 405 of the Securities Act
Securities registered: Units (SIMAU), Class A ordinary shares (SIMA), Warrants (SIMAW) — all on Nasdaq
